source_snapshot.title: Road towards Dubai to be temporarily closed for Etihad Rail work
source_snapshot.text: As work on the UAE’s national rail service gains steam, a road towards Dubai will be temporarily closed for a short period from tomorrow, October 20, until October 27. Etihad Rail posted the news on social media, saying that due to the ongoing infrastructure works, the exit from Maliha Road towards Dubai (Emirates Road) will be temporarily closed between midnight and 4am. The road will be affected for one week. . Etihad Rail launched its first trip ferrying passengers on September 29. It took people from Al Yalayis Station (Jumeirah Golf Estates) in Dubai to Mohammed Bin Zayed City Station in Abu Dhabi..Get updated faster and for FREE: Download the Gulf News app now - simply click here.. If you are going to the Dubai station via the Metro, a new bridge opened on October 15, allowing travellers to take an air-conditioned path from Jumeirah Golf Estates Metro Station to Al Yalayis Station. For more information on the bridge, click here.Tickets on the new railway line start at Dh39, but there are special fares for families. Infants who are under two years of age travel free when seated on an accompanying adult’s lap. Kids who are ages 2 to 17 pay 50 per cent of the adult fare. And seniors – or those over 60 – pay 20 per cent. .Etihad Rail Dubai-Abu Dhabi tickets are on sale: Fares, timings, booking, parking and station features.Dubai Etihad Rail–Metro pedestrian bridge opens: Five-minute walk connects stations.Etihad Rail: How to reach Dubai and Abu Dhabi stations without a car.Etihad Rail passenger train completes Abu Dhabi-Dubai journey

claims.claim: From October 20 to 27, the exit from Maliha Road to Emirates Road towards Dubai will be temporarily closed.
The closure is from midnight to 4am due to infrastructure works on the Etihad Rail national railway.
Etihad Rail began passenger services on September 29, connecting stations in Dubai and Abu Dhabi.
A new air-conditioned pedestrian bridge opened between Jumeirah Golf Estates Metro Station and Al Yalayis Station for passenger convenience.

title: Road towards Dubai to be temporarily closed for Etihad Rail work
summary_ru: 🚇 Временное закрытие дороги к Дубаю из-за работ Etihad Rail 📅 С 20 по 27 октября будет временно закрыт съезд с дороги Малиха на Emirates Road в сторону Дубая. Ограничение действует с полуночи до 4 утра из-за инфраструктурных работ на национальной железной дороге Etihad Rail. 🚇 Etihad Rail начала пассажирские перевозки 29 сентября, связывая станции в Дубае и Абу-Даби. Для удобства пассажиров открыт новый пешеходный мост с кондиционированием между станцией метро Jumeirah Golf Estates и станцией Al Yalayis.
